from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re, subprocess
root = Path.cwd()
stage = root / "logs/v0.1.3"
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
baseline = json.loads((stage / "input_hashes.json").read_text())
changed = [p for p, h in baseline.items() if not Path(p).exists() or sha(Path(p)) != h]
assert not changed, changed
print(f"Protected files unchanged: {len(baseline)} (old proofs/docs/logs, roadmap, pinned config, logger, external project config and elan settings).")
old_progress = (stage / "before_PROGRESS.md").read_bytes()
assert (root / "PROGRESS.md").read_bytes().endswith(old_progress)
print("PROGRESS retains the complete previous text byte-for-byte.")

def uncomment(text):
    result, i, depth = [], 0, 0
    while i < len(text):
        if text.startswith("/-", i):
            depth += 1
            i += 2
        elif depth and text.startswith("-/", i):
            depth -= 1
            i += 2
        elif depth:
            if text[i] == "\n":
                result.append("\n")
            i += 1
        elif text.startswith("--", i):
            j = text.find("\n", i)
            i = len(text) if j == -1 else j
        else:
            result.append(text[i])
            i += 1
    assert depth == 0
    return "".join(result)

modules = sorted((root / "LeanPML").rglob("*.lean"))
formal = modules + [root / "LeanPML.lean", root / "Audit.lean"]
assert len(modules) == 6 and len(formal) == 8
names, counts = [], {}
for f in formal:
    code = uncomment(f.read_text())
    assert not re.search(r"\b(sorry|admit|sorryAx|axiom)\b", code), f
    ns = re.findall(r"^namespace (\S+)\s*$", code, re.M)
    local = re.findall(r"^theorem (\S+)", code, re.M)
    if local:
        assert len(ns) == 1, (f, ns)
        names += [ns[0] + "." + n for n in local]
    counts[str(f.relative_to(root))] = len(local)
    artifact = root / ".lake/build/lib/lean" / f.relative_to(root).with_suffix(".olean")
    assert artifact.exists(), artifact
assert len(names) == len(set(names)) == 59
assert counts["LeanPML/Time/Constancy.lean"] == 2
assert counts["LeanPML/PML/TimeInvariants.lean"] == 25
assert len(re.findall(r"^noncomputable def ", uncomment((root/"LeanPML/PML/TimeInvariants.lean").read_text()), re.M)) == 7
audited = re.findall(r"^#print axioms (\S+)", uncomment((root / "Audit.lean").read_text()), re.M)
assert len(audited) == len(set(audited)) == 59 and set(audited) == set(names)
imports = set(re.findall(r"^import (\S+)", (root / "LeanPML.lean").read_text(), re.M))
expected_imports = {".".join(f.relative_to(root).with_suffix("").parts) for f in modules}
assert imports == expected_imports
assert 'defaultTargets = ["LeanPML", "Audit"]' in (root / "lakefile.toml").read_text()
print("Formal build coverage: 6 modules + 2 root entries; all 8 .olean files present.")
print("Theorems:", json.dumps(counts, ensure_ascii=False))
print("Audit coverage: all 59 theorems, including 27 new; no proof placeholders or custom axiom declarations in formal code.")

def metadata(stem, exit_code, command):
    m = json.loads((stage / (stem + ".json")).read_text())
    assert m["cwd"] == str(root) and m["status"] == "finished"
    assert m["exit_code"] == exit_code and m["command"] == command
    print(f"{stem}: command={m['command_display']}; cwd={m['cwd']}; exit={m['exit_code']}")
    return (stage / m["output_file"]).read_text()
failure = metadata("20261010T110106_690944_lake_build", 1, ["lake", "build"])
assert "Type mismatch" in failure
build = metadata("20261010T110154_522300_lake_build_retry", 0, ["lake", "build"])
assert "Build completed successfully (2117 jobs)." in build
audit = metadata("20261010T110440_468487_axioms_audit", 0, ["lake", "env", "lean", "Audit.lean"])
entries = re.findall(r"'([^']+)' depends on axioms: \[([^\]]*)\]", audit)
assert len(entries) == 59 and {n for n,_ in entries} == set(names)
allowed = {"propext", "Classical.choice", "Quot.sound"}
assert all(set(x.strip() for x in axioms.split(",")) == allowed for _, axioms in entries)
assert "sorryAx" not in audit
print("All 59 independent audit results have exactly the standard dependency set: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.")

manifest = json.loads((root / "lake-manifest.json").read_text())
assert len(manifest["packages"]) == 9
for package in manifest["packages"]:
    actual = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(root / ".lake/packages" / package["name"]), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
    assert actual == package["rev"], (package["name"], actual, package["rev"])
print("All 9 dependency checkout revisions match the unchanged manifest.")
roadmap = root / "ROADMAP_lean_PML_revised.md"
old_inputs = json.loads((root / "logs/v0.1.2/input_hashes.json").read_text())
print("Roadmap v0.1.2 snapshot hash:", old_inputs[str(roadmap)])
print("Roadmap current hash:", sha(roadmap))
assert sha(roadmap) == "ea0598a824d40ed1678b3b36e61a3329b9086625cc957839ca947b0acd6fb39e"
for filename in ["model_contract.md", "theorem_inventory.md", "scope.md"]:
    f = root / "docs" / filename
    assert sha(f) == old_inputs[str(f)], f
v7 = root.parent / "results/V7_Maxwell_Debye_PML/V7_global_energy.md"
assert sha(v7) == "0a7f73a25cb119eeb75b3e7b3c3f2fbb3b319250f3354ed4dcad0ecff8eff4fb"
print("Contract/theorem inventory/scope match v0.1.2; V7 source matches source_inventory.")
print("V7 source:", str(v7), sha(v7))
assert not (root / "LeanPML/PML/Coefficients.lean").exists()
assert not (root / "LeanPML/PML/Weights.lean").exists()
print("v0.2.1 implementation files have not been created.")

for filename in ["README.md", "PROGRESS.md"]:
    text = (root / filename).read_text()
    if filename == "PROGRESS.md":
        text = text[:text.index("---\n\n以下为此前进度原文")]
    assert len(re.findall(r"^\$\$\s*$", text, re.M)) % 2 == 0, filename
    assert len(re.findall(r"^~~~", text, re.M)) % 2 == 0, filename
    assert "¤" not in text, filename
    for target in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)", text):
        target = target.strip("<>").split("#",1)[0]
        if re.match(r"https?://", target):
            continue
        target = re.sub(r":\d+$", "", target)
        assert (root / target).exists(), (filename, target)
print("New README/PROGRESS links exist; display math and code fences are paired.")

artifacts = formal + [root / n for n in ["README.md", "lean-toolchain", "lakefile.toml", "lake-manifest.json", "scripts/run_logged.py"]]
(stage / "verified_artifact_hashes.json").write_text(json.dumps({str(f.relative_to(root)): sha(f) for f in artifacts}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
print("Saved verified_artifact_hashes.json (compiled formal sources, README, pinned configuration and logger).")
print("v0.1.3 final checks passed.")
